	final String endpoint;
	final String bearerToken;

	Client(

		this.bearerToken,
	);

	// getAuthorizationHeader returns the value for the Authorization header.
	String getAuthorizationHeader() {
		return 'Bearer $bearerToken';
	}
}

		);
	}

		return {
			'error': errorMessage,
		};
	}
}
